key_insight: LLM agents can execute prohibited actions when tool responses omit safety-critical facts, even if the user request is benign and every returned statement is true.
engineering_relevance: Safety-sensitive agent workflows should support explicit evidence recovery and verify that recovered facts guide both safe refusal and permissible task completion.
method: Evaluate 300 matched unsafe/safe task pairs across six domains.
Systematically suppress critical facts to measure unsafe execution and the minimum observed omission count triggering failure.
Use an independent audit tool to test evidence acquisition and appropriate action.
evidence_signal: Across ten models, recovery access reduced unsafe execution for every model, but evidence acquisition and appropriate action varied substantially.
watch_item: Robustness to missing evidence does not guarantee useful recovery; evaluate both prohibited-action avoidance and permissible-task completion.
paper_title: EpiSEM-Bench: Evaluating Safety and Evidence Recovery in LLM Agents under Missing Evidence
